one_line: Sultan of Ahmadnagar and battlefield leader of the Deccan coalition at Talikota, 1565 CE.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, medium height, lean but battle-hardened build
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, wheatish-brown complexion, neatly trimmed medium-length black beard with a slight fork at the chin, straight nose, intense almond-shaped eyes with a focused gaze, default expression calm and calculating with a hint of stern resolve
appearance.hair: Black hair gathered under a deep emerald-green quilted turban wrapped flat and low, with a narrow white under-turban band visible at the forehead and a small gold crescent-shaped turban ornament slightly off-center
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved cream cotton jama (Mughal-style wrap coat) that crosses left over right and ties at the side, he wears a knee-length dark indigo quilted coat (zirh-jama) with vertical stitching and a subtle chevron pattern, lightly padded but close-fitting; the coat flares slightly at the hips and is belted at the waist with a broad maroon leather belt bearing a simple brass buckle and a couple of small pouch attachments; below, he has loose, tapered white churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles and soft dark-brown leather riding boots rising mid-calf with a slight heel; over his shoulders is a muted olive-green woollen shawl-cloak pinned at the right shoulder, its edge bordered by a narrow gold woven stripe, draped back to leave his arms free; he wears a short mail coif suggested at the neckline and mail visible under his sleeves at the wrists, plus simple gold stud earrings and a single ruby-set gold ring on his sword hand
appearance.signature: A slightly curved, slim Deccan talwar with a dark steel blade, a disc pommel and a gently flared cross-guard, sheathed in a deep maroon scabbard with brass chape, worn slantwise at his left hip and often drawn halfway with his right hand in a commanding pose

ref_desc: Hussain Nizam Shah I is a mid-40s, wheatish-brown, sharp-featured man with an emerald-green turban, cream jama under a dark indigo quilted coat, white churidar trousers, olive-green shawl, maroon-belted talwar at his left hip and dark-brown riding boots.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Hussain Nizam Shah I as a dignified Deccan sultan and battlefield commander in 1565: a mid-40s man of medium height with a lean, battle-hardened build, wheatish-brown complexion, an oval face, sharp cheekbones, a straight nose and intense almond-shaped eyes, his default expression calm and calculating with a hint of stern resolve; he has a neatly trimmed medium-length black beard slightly forked at the chin and black hair covered by a deep emerald-green quilted turban wrapped flat and low, a narrow white band visible at the forehead and a small gold crescent ornament pinned slightly off-center; dress him in a long-sleeved cream cotton jama crossing left over right, over which he wears a knee-length dark indigo quilted coat with vertical stitching and subtle chevron texture, belted with a broad maroon leather belt bearing a simple brass buckle and a couple of small pouches; show hints of mail at the neckline and wrists; on his lower body, depict loose white churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles and soft dark-brown leather riding boots reaching mid-calf; drape an olive-green woollen shawl-cloak with a narrow gold border over his shoulders, pinned at the right shoulder and flowing behind but leaving his arms free; at his left hip, hang his signature slightly curved Deccan talwar in a deep maroon scabbard with brass fittings, the disc-pommelled hilt evident in his right hand as if he’s about to draw; keep the dominant colours emerald green, dark indigo, cream, olive green and maroon, and show him from multiple angles (front, side, back) to clearly present face, hair, full costume and weapon in a crisp, historically grounded anime style.
